notes.title: A Brief Look at the Cthulhu Mythos and Its Influence on Cthulhu Keeper
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45495274/533ed136ffba30bb01c156c42825bcd51a885f33.png[/img]
Cthulhu Keeper is an upcoming real-time tactics game from Finnish developer Kuuasema. You play as the leader of a hidden cult devoted to ancient gods, embarking on a mad quest to please your terrible masters. Develop your cult's secret hideout to unlock new powers, and undertake covert missions to retrieve artifacts, eliminate rivals, and perform dark rituals.

As the name suggests, the game is inspired by the Cthulhu Mythos, originally created by American horror writer H.P. Lovecraft in his 1928 short story The Call of Cthulhu. Since then, the Cthulhu Mythos has grown into a shared fictional universe, expanded by numerous other writers. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45495274/d5963b859ca71f9a8d920c206c2f5d5ade4288a3.gif[/img]

The Mythos is known for its themes of cosmic horror - terror not born of blood and gore, but from the realization that humanity is a mere dust particle in a universe ruled by incomprehensible forces. In Cthulhu Keeper, you embrace this unsettling truth. Operating in the shadows of a 1920s city, you carve out a lair beneath society’s feet, build forbidden knowledge, and summon beings whose very presence erodes sanity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45495274/4e9ed7746e245f395534d2e8cd604a6fc834dbf5.png[/img]
Rather than retelling Lovecraft’s stories directly, the game draws from the tone and symbols of the Mythos - arcane tomes, lurking monstrosities, and creeping madness. Fans - and soon-to-be-fans - of the genre may recognize creatures like the Gug or Shoggoth, but they’ll also discover a strategic layer: managing a cult is more than just worship - it’s about defending your lair, orchestrating stealth missions, and manipulating the world above without drawing too much attention.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45495274/f4ce73368c4bccb6f898182149354bedd72f00a1.gif[/img]

We know the Cthulhu Mythos has a dedicated and discerning following, and we approach it with respect. Cthulhu Keeper is not an encyclopedia of eldritch lore, but rather a fresh interpretation shaped by classic strategy games and cosmic horror. Think of it as an initiation into something darker - a whisper of what lies beyond, where you command not heroes, but the cultists who heed the call of the void.

- High Priests / Kuuasema

notes.title: Cthulhu Keeper Playtest Now Open!
notes.notes:
Hello Cultists!

The time has come to unleash your inner darkness. We're thrilled to announce that [b]Cthulhu Keeper is now open for public playtesting![/b]

Dive into the shadows and experience a unique blend of real-time stealth tactics and dungeon management. Construct your lair, summon eldritch creatures, and spread madness across the land. 
Whether you're a seasoned dungeon overlord or a newcomer eager to embrace the unknown, this is your chance to shape the game's future.

[u][b]Playtest Details:[/b][/u]
⏰​ From March 17th
​​​​🐙​ Access: Click the "Request Access" button on our Steam page to join.
​💬​ The playtest version is currently available exclusively in English. 
​📺​ Livestreams and videos are welcome if you have a Twitch or YouTube channel.

[i]Please mention that this is a playtest version and not the final version of the game 😉
You can also share the link to the steam page in your chat, if you want to support us.[/i]

Your feedback is invaluable. We encourage you to provide them in English. Join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/cthulhukeeper]Discord server[/url] to share your thoughts, report bugs, and discuss strategies with fellow Keepers.

The abyss awaits your command.

notes.title: Praise Cthulhu! Announcing Cthulhu Keeper.
notes.notes:
Hello Cultists!

We are happy to announce Cthulhu Keeper, a real-time tactics and dungeon-building game set in the eerie 1920s and inspired by H.P. Lovecraft’s universe. In Cthulhu Keeper, you assume the role of a cult leader weaving a web of dark influence. 

Do you hear it, Keeper? Get a glimpse of the darkness by watching our [b]reveal trailer[/b]!
[previewyoutube=LuZ7OQEMCk8;full][/previewyoutube]

[list][*] 📜 Build Your Cult: Carve out a monstrous lair, research forbidden tomes, and summon a menagerie of Lovecraftian horrors. 
[*] 🔎 Gather Resources: Collect flesh, valuable artifacts, and clay tablets to fuel your research and expansion.
[*] 🐙​ Spread the Madness: Explore the city streets, recruit cultists, and complete objectives to expand your influence. 
[*] 🏹​ Defend Your Domain: Fortify your lair with traps and spells to repel rival cults and the ever-inquisitive authorities.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45495274/fc89b666382cf5524daf1ddffa066ce013f1108f.png[/img]

[i]Whispers speak of upcoming playtests for Cthulhu Keeper... Alas, we can reveal no more at this time, for unseen eyes are watching…[/i]
